intro: Find where to set the Fence for a Bevel Cut, so the Part ends up the length you want on its Long Face or its Short Face.

angle.label: Bevel Angle
angle.hint: From 0° (upright blade) to 45°, as read on your saw's bevel scale.

thickness.label: Thickness
thickness.hint: For example 19, 3/4" or 19 mm. Without a unit, numbers use your preferred Unit System.

givenFace.label: Length you give
givenFace.hint: The Long Face is the one away from the table; the Short Face rests on it.

length.hint: For example 300, 11 13/16" or 300 mm. Without a unit, numbers use your preferred Unit System.

fencePosition.title: Fence Position
fencePosition.description: Distance from the blade to the Fence, as read on your saw's ruler.

note.title: Check your saw.
note.text: The blade is taken to meet the table at the ruler's zero at every Bevel Angle. If your saw's blade pivots elsewhere, make a test Part first.

errors.angleUnreadable: That angle can't be read. Type degrees, like 22.5.
errors.angleOutOfRange: The Bevel Angle must be between 0° and 45°.
errors.lengthUnreadable: That length can't be read. Try something like 89 mm, 3 1/2" or 6' 4 1/4".
errors.notPositive: A length must be greater than zero.
errors.longFaceTooShort: At {{ angle }}° the Long Face must be longer than {{ minimum }}. Try a longer length or a smaller Bevel Angle.

otherFace.long: The Long Face is the Short Face plus Thickness × tan of the Bevel Angle.
otherFace.short: The Short Face equals the Fence Position.
